# Förvaltarna tipsar: Bolagen som kan skrälla i rapporterna

**Feed**: borslunch  
**Published**: 2026-10-09  
**Market Sentiment**: Positive

⏱️ **Time Horizon Key**: ST = <3 months | MT = 3-12 months | LT = >12 months

---

## Episode Thesis

Börslunch (EFN) on a strong Friday for the Stockholm market, with Handelsbanken's Christian Brun and REC's Adnan Hadzic Fendic as guests. They discuss the Q3 report season, AI-driven market leadership and serial acquirers. Adnan expects positive report surprises in companies with easy year-ago comparisons (Hexatronic, Hoist, Surgical Science, Truecaller, WeSports). Christian backs Storskogen as a turnaround and a proxy for the Swedish economy. The guests also cover Constellation Software, Hexagon's expensive Rocscience deal, Sleep Cycle's related-party Audiowell deal and a shrinking IPO window. The tone is broadly constructive: small-cap earnings growth is expected to recover to about 15% this year and next.

---

## Universe Stocks

### 🟢 HTRO — Hexatronic | **BUY** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: ST  
**Confidence**: 65%

Guest Adnan (REC) picks it as a likely positive Q3 surprise: easy comparisons, a fantastic half-year, upbeat management, strong US business.

#### Reasoning

Guest opinion. Adnan screened his portfolio for companies with strong H1 reports that had weak Q3 reports last year, so year-on-year comparisons are easy. Hexatronic has turned around strongly this year, management has been upbeat at seminars, the US market is strong and recent acquisitions add growth. He expects a strong Q3 report.

#### Sell Triggers

- Q3 report misses on US demand
- management guidance turns cautious
- fiber cycle turns down again

> *"Så jag tror att det är... är bra tryck i maskineriet där, inte minst i den amerikanska marknaden."*

---

### 🟢 HOFI — Hoist Finance | **BUY** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 65%

Guest says new financial targets are not priced in by analysts and earnings growth is good; host says own Hoist rather than Intrum.

#### Reasoning

Guest opinion, with the host agreeing. The shares have performed very well this year. Adjusting for seasonally weaker portfolio purchases, earnings growth is solid. The new financial targets are not yet reflected in analyst estimates, which leaves room for upward revisions. The host prefers it over Intrum.

#### Sell Triggers

- portfolio purchase volumes fall short
- new financial targets abandoned
- credit quality deteriorates

> *"Bolaget har nya finansiella mål som analytikerna absolut inte riktigt har prissatt in. Den tror jag kan bli bra."*

---

### 🟢 SUS — Surgical Science | **BUY** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 60%

Easy comparisons, back on good terms with Intuitive, FDA push for simulation software, large net cash versus market cap, not expensive.

#### Reasoning

Guest opinion. After a tough prior year, including Intuitive ending a contract, the relationship is restored and many new robotic-surgery companies are emerging. FDA backing for simulation software is a structural tailwind. The H1 report was strong and the stock is recovering step by step; another good report could lift it a further step. The valuation is undemanding with large net cash.

#### Sell Triggers

- Q3 fails to confirm the recovery trend
- Intuitive relationship deteriorates again
- FDA tailwind fails to materialize

> *"Är vi inne på samma trend, då kommer aktien ta ett trappsteg till. Den är inte speciellt dyr."*

---

### 🟠 TRUE-B — Truecaller | **WATCH** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: ST  
**Confidence**: 40%

On guest's list of potential positive Q3 surprises because of easy comparisons; no further detail.

#### Reasoning

Guest opinion. Truecaller appeared on Adnan's screen of portfolio holdings with a strong H1 and a weak Q3 last year, suggesting easy comparisons. It was not discussed beyond being named, so conviction is low.

#### Sell Triggers

- Q3 report disappoints despite easy comparisons

> *"Hexatronic, Hoist, SUS, Truecooler och Weesports."*

---

### 🟢 STOR-B — Storskogen | **BUY** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 65%

Christian (Handelsbanken) has bought a lot this year: clean-up done, debt down, acquisitions restarting, organic growth turning. A proxy for the Swedish economy.

#### Reasoning

Guest opinion. Christian's fund has built a position this year. Storskogen has cut debt and cleaned up its portfolio and is now positioned to acquire again. Organic growth turned in the right direction in Q2. It is the listed company most exposed to Sweden, so faster Swedish growth should show in its numbers. Adnan agrees on the improvement but notes many acquisitions are needed to move a SEK 40bn company.

#### Sell Triggers

- organic growth fails to recover
- Swedish economic recovery stalls
- leverage rises again from acquisitions

> *"Nu är man i startläge och bör köpa."*

---

### 🟢 CSU — Constellation Software | **BUY** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: LT  
**Confidence**: 60%

Adnan sees it as a long-term winner. Its back-end, can't-fail software is hard for AI to disrupt, succession is in place, and it may benefit from private equity sell-downs.

#### Reasoning

Guest opinion. The stock had a tough year on fears around software and AI plus the CEO's departure. Adnan argues the succession plan is a sign of strength. He says deeply integrated back-end software differs from consumer-facing software and is hard for AI to replace. With its disciplined acquisition record (it would not pay 24-25x earnings), it should gain from private equity owners being forced to sell.

#### Sell Triggers

- AI disruption hits back-end vertical software
- acquisition discipline weakens
- returns on capital decline

> *"så tror jag att de är en stor vinnare över tid"*

---

### 🟠 ATRLJ-B — Atrium Ljungberg | **WATCH** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Mixed | **Time Horizon**: LT  
**Confidence**: 50%

Weak report with vacancy at 14%. The Hagastaden/Ericsson projects are too far off to trade on now, but it could have among the best upside when property sentiment turns.

#### Reasoning

Guest opinion (Christian). The report was weak, mainly due to rising vacancy, and sentiment and flows in property stocks are poor. Large visionary projects such as building for Ericsson in Hagastaden are years away and should not be credited now. Once sector sentiment turns, Atrium could be among the property stocks with the most potential.

#### Sell Triggers

- vacancy keeps rising
- Ericsson project delayed or scaled back
- property sector sentiment stays weak

> *"Så vid nåt tillfälle när det vänder sentimentet för fastighetsaktierna så är väl det en av de aktierna som kanske har bäst potential."*

---

### ⛔ HEXA-B — Hexagon | **AVOID** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Negative | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 45%

Adnan says the Rocscience deal looks very expensive at 24-25x 2026 earnings and finds Hexagon hard to understand; he owns none. JP Morgan says buy.

#### Reasoning

Guest opinion that conflicts with analyst opinion. Adnan contrasts Hexagon with Constellation, which would never pay 24-25x forward earnings, and says he still finds the company hard to understand. JP Morgan raised its target and recommends buy, and the shares rose ~4% on the deal. This is a weak avoid view based on capital allocation.

#### Sell Triggers

- Rocscience deal proves accretive
- clearer strategy improves understandability

> *"Jag vet inte vad deras plan är med bolaget men det ser onekligen väldigt dyrt ut."*

---

### ⛔ INTRUM — Intrum | **AVOID** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Negative | **Time Horizon**: ST  
**Confidence**: 45%

Down sharply with no known news; host says own Hoist instead.

#### Reasoning

Host opinion. Intrum fell significantly during the week without an identified catalyst. The host states in passing that one should own Hoist rather than Intrum, so the conviction is weak and offhand.

#### Sell Triggers

- clear turnaround in Intrum results
- debt restructuring success

> *"Sant, det där med Intrum, man ska äga Hoist istället, den saken är väl klar."*

---

### ⛔ SLEEP — Sleep Cycle | **AVOID** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Negative | **Time Horizon**: ST  
**Confidence**: 40%

Up 20%+ on the Audiowell deal with Altor on both sides. Aktiespararna's lawyer and the hosts see a governance concern.

#### Reasoning

Cited opinion from Aktiespararna's lawyer plus host scepticism. Altor failed to buy out Sleep Cycle and failed to sell Audiowell, and is now merging them via a non-cash issue that triggers a mandatory bid obligation, gaining control. Deals where private equity trades with itself raise minority-shareholder concerns, although Audiowell could be a good business.

#### Sell Triggers

- independent fairness opinion supports the deal
- Audiowell proves strongly value-accretive

> *"Det är alltid när riskkapitalbolag gör affärer med sig själva. så blir man lite fundersam."*

---

### 🟡 ADDT-B — Addtech | **HOLD** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Neutral | **Time Horizon**: LT  
**Confidence**: 50%

Both guests own it. They see the recent drop as a temporary fund-flow effect (small-cap fund procurement), not fundamentals.

#### Reasoning

Guest opinion. Addtech fell ~7.5% on Wednesday. The DNB Carnegie target cut was only about SEK 5 and is not seen as the trigger. Christian thinks fund reshuffling after a small-cap fund procurement process is creating temporary outflows from a widely held stock. Both guests continue to hold it as a quality serial acquirer.

#### Sell Triggers

- fundamental profit warning
- sustained outflows from small-cap funds

> *"Det kan ha varit en tillfällig grej."*

---
